status: Post-result diagnostic stress test, fixed before these new fits; not external validation
target: Measured W0 PP-NRS>=4 and measured W0-W12 drop>=4
grouping: Recorded baseline IL-4 assay_file. Alias labels use sorted unique source filenames in the full baseline IL-4 assay table before cohort restriction. Source files are not confirmed biological or analytical batches for every marker.
outer_design: Leave one of four source-file groups out; all held-out patients are predicted once per model
predictors: Same baseline columns as the current three-marker and panel-size analyses; assay-file/group itself is excluded from predictor columns
selection: Training-only median imputation, standardization, SelectKBest f_classif inside inner pipeline; same mean inner log-loss and sample-ddof1 1SE compact choice; strongest shrinkage breaks exact C ties
aggregate_interval: Conditional patient bootstrap within each held-out assay-file group, retaining its observed group size. No refitting or assay-file-universe resampling.
single_class_group: AUROC and AUPRC not estimable; all patients retained for Brier and log-loss. No synthetic class is added.
interpretation: Assay-file membership, centre, treatment and baseline case mix overlap; held-out performance is a joint transport stress test. A decline does not identify measurement artifact or a causal batch effect. No main selection rule or candidate is revised from these results.
